question: In treasury_yields_2024.csv, count the trading days on which the 3 Mo yield was strictly higher than the 10 Yr yield (an inverted bill-to-bond curve) and the 2 Yr yield was also strictly higher than the 10 Yr yield. Report the count.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'/treasury_yields_2024.csv')
print(int(((a['3 Mo']>a['10 Yr'])&(a['2 Yr']>a['10 Yr'])).sum()))
